## Information
Bring a touch of sparkle to your festive decor with the Livingandhome Collapsible Christmas Tree. Designed with dense, shimmering tinsel, it creates a bright and eye-catching display that adds a cheerful Christmas atmosphere to any room. Its full, bushy appearance makes it an attractive alternative to a traditional tree, while the collapsible design allows for convenient storage when the festive season is over. Whether placed in the living room, hallway or another favourite corner, it can instantly enhance your seasonal decorations without taking up excessive space. Setting up the tree is also straightforward, with the tinsel, tubes and sturdy base simply connected together for a complete display. Enjoy a stylish and festive centrepiece with minimal effort, ready to complement your Christmas decorations.

Whether you're decorating your home or a store, this tree blends convenience with eye-catching style, making it a standout choice for the holidays.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- The modern white twig design adds a clean, festive accent to tables, shelves, consoles and windowsills.
- Warm white LED lighting adds gentle illumination and a welcoming ambience to your display.
- USB or 3 x AA battery operation allows flexible indoor placement without relying on a fixed power outlet.
- Adjust the posable branches to shape the tree and create a fuller decorative finish.
- Lightweight construction makes the tree easy to reposition, pack away and reuse for Christmas or other celebrations.
- Made from PVC with a clean white branch finish for a crisp, modern decorative look.
- Twenty-four steady warm white LEDs create a soft ambient glow for seasonal and decorative displays.
- Choose USB power or 3 x AA batteries for flexible placement; batteries are not included.
- Shape the posable branches to create a fuller display tailored to your space.
- Fire-retardant design supports safer seasonal decorating indoors.

## Information
Add a soft seasonal glow to your home with this 60cm white twig tree from Shatchi. It features 24 steady warm white LEDs for gentle ambient lighting, making it suitable for Christmas displays and everyday décor. The posable branches can be shaped to create your preferred look on tables, consoles, shelves, windowsills or bedside spaces. Its clean white finish brings a contemporary touch to modern interiors. Choose USB power or use 3×AA batteries, not included, for flexible indoor placement without relying on a nearby mains socket. The PVC construction is designed for repeat seasonal use, while the pop-up format and foldable stand support easy setup and storage. Not suitable for children under 36 months.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- The modern white twig design adds a clean, festive accent to tables, shelves, consoles and windowsills.
- Warm white LED lighting creates soft ambient illumination without overpowering your decorative arrangement.
- USB or battery operation allows the tree to be displayed indoors without relying on a fixed power connection.
- Arrange the posable branches to create the shape and fullness that best suits your space.
- Lightweight construction makes the tree easy to position, pack away and reuse for Christmas or other decorative occasions.
- Made from PVC with a clean white twig-style branch finish for a modern decorative look.
- Twenty-four steady warm white LEDs provide a gentle glow for an inviting seasonal display.
- Choose USB power or 3 x AA batteries for flexible placement; batteries are not included.
- Posable branches can be arranged to create a fuller, more personalised decorative shape.
- Fire-retardant design provides an added consideration for seasonal indoor decorating.

## Information
Add a soft seasonal glow to your home with this 60cm white twig tree from Shatchi. It features 24 steady warm white LEDs for gentle ambient lighting, making it suitable for Christmas displays and everyday décor. The posable branches can be shaped to create your preferred look on tables, consoles, shelves, windowsills or bedside spaces. Its clean white finish brings a contemporary touch to modern interiors. Choose USB power or use 3×AA batteries, not included, for flexible indoor placement without relying on a nearby mains socket. The PVC construction is designed for repeat seasonal use, while the pop-up format and foldable stand support easy setup and storage. Not suitable for children under 36 months.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Three Size Options
- Enchanting warm white LEDs
- Versatile Indoor  Outdoor Use
- The built-in timer switches the lights on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours, helping automate daily operation.
- A 5 m lead provides flexible positioning for indoor displays, outdoor decoration and commercial settings.
- Suitable for Christmas celebrations, year-round garden decoration, shop displays and commercial premises.
- The twinkle effect adds gentle movement to the warm white lighting, while the timer supports convenient scheduled use.
- The pop-up design makes the tree quick to position and easy to pack away after use.
- Full assembly instructions and a video tutorial are included for straightforward setup.
- Limited assembly is required, and the tree folds down to a compact size for storage in smaller spaces.

## Information
Elevate your festive decor and be the envy of your neighbours with our stunning LED Christmas with twinkle effect , available in three sizes 0.9 meters with 200 LEDs or 1.8 meters with 480 LEDs or 2.5m with 720 LEDs. Featuring warm white effect LEDs with twinkling effect, this tree creates a magical festive ambiance. Perfect for both indoor and outdoor use, it comes with a 5-meter lead and a convenient timer function power supply that cycles 6 hours on and 18 hours off. Designed for durability in various weather conditions, it's ideal for Christmas and festive celebrations, year-round garden decor, and commercial displays.Transform any space into a festive wonderland with this enchanting LED Christmas Tree.

## Features
- Divided into 3 sections for space-saving storage
- Wonderful decoration with 280 warm white LED lights
- Equipped with a secure adaptor that is UKCA certificated
- Comes with a preinstalled bolt for perfect hole alignment
- 758 lush branch tips create a realistic appearance

## Information
The 6 ft Xmas tree with dreamy blue branches has 758 vivid tips that create a fairy tale fantasy. It is pre-lit with 280 warm white LED lights that offer a cozy glow, transforming any room into a holiday haven. Made from safe and enduring PVC, the decoration tree is fireproof, non-allergic, smell-free, and anti-fading. The hinged design allows for easy setup, with a folding metal stand for optimal stability for wide use. The Xmas tree is versatile and leaves a lasting impression at first glance, making it suitable for living rooms, office parties, and commercial spaces, serving as the perfect centerpiece for spreading warm wishes throughout the holiday season.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Artificial Christmas tree with bendable branches
- Dense foliage in rich green for a realistic appearance
- Quick assembly and disassembly via the plug-in system
- Stable tree stand made of powder-coated steel with floor-protecting plastic feet
- Easy to maintain

## Information
Realistic AppearanceThe artificial Christmas tree Dasher from tectake brings the festive glow of the Christmas season into your home! The artificial fir tree impresses with its rich, deep green needles and the numerous tips on the shapeable branches. This combination ensures a magnificent volume, making the tree difficult to distinguish from the real thing.High Stability and Easy AssemblyIt's not just the Christmas trees festive look that stands out but also its functionality. The stable tree stand made of powder-coated steel is easily foldable and, in combination with the non-slip plastic feet, ensures a secure stand. The Christmas trees simple plug-in system allows for easy assembly, while the flexible branches can be easily shaped to suit your taste. The Xmas tree is ready for decorating in no time and is guaranteed to become the shining centrepiece of your celebrations.The realistic Christmas tree is made from high-quality materials and is therefore very durable. Unlike a real tree, you don't have to worry about drying branches or needles shedding. This fir tree remains a fresh and lush evergreen throughout the Christmas season and will add a festive atmosphere to your home for years. After the festive season, the Christmas tree can be quickly and easily dismantled into its individual parts. This way, it takes up hardly any storage space and will shine in full splendour again next year.With the artificial Christmas tree Dasher from tectake, you not only bring a festive centrepiece into your home but also an enchanting Christmas spirit, year after year.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Includes 2 types of leaves with different textures and shades
- Hinged branches save time because sections fall into place
- Stays upright with a stable crossed metal base

## Information
Are you ready for the coming Christmas? Our pre-lit hinged Christmas tree can better decorate your home during holiday season. This realistic pine tree with snowy design, pine cones and red berries will bring you more joy than simple traditional Christmas tree. Comes with 581 PE & PVC branch tips, this realistic pine tree has a full-bodied appearance. Besides, evenly distributed 250 multi-color LED lights with 11 dynamic effects provide different beautiful scenes at daytime and night time, creating charming lighting show and strong festival vibe. Thanks to hinged design, all branches can drop to the designed place, which will save your time on assembly. Supported by folding metal base, this Christmas tree ensures high stability and easy storage. All in all, our realistic Xmas tree perfectly matches with all occasions, wishing you a sparkling Christmas and happy new year.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Includes 2 types of leaves with different textures and shades
- Hinged branches save time because sections fall into place
- Stays upright with a stable crossed metal base

## Information
Light up the Season!This pre-lit artificial Christmas tree brings a richly layered holiday look with full branch tips, combining frosted PE leaves and snow-sprayed PVC leaves for a lush, dimensional profile. The silhouette is enhanced by 28/35/43 pine cones and 28/35/43 clusters of red berries, giving this realistic Christmas tree a cozy woodland character that feels festive from every angle. Color-changing illumination adds even more charm, with 250/350/450 LED lights offering warm white and multicolored settings across 11 lighting modes (combination, C1 steady on, C2 steady on, C1 mixture, C2 mixture, slo-glo, breathing, C1 slo-glo, C2 slo-glo, flash, in wave). Setup feels refreshingly simple thanks to the hinged branch construction and 3-section trunk, which help the shape fall into place with less effort during assembly and pack away more neatly after the season. A reinforced X-shaped metal stand and sturdy trunk help the holiday tree stay balanced while holding ornaments, ribbons, and garlands, while scratch-resistant foot pads offer added floor protection. Made from flame-retardant, fade-resistant, smell-free, and non-allergic PVC and PE materials, it is designed for lasting beauty and dependable seasonal use in homes with children and pets.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Elegant arch frames an indoor doorway
- Snow-dusted tips and decorative pine cones
- Flame-retardant plastic construction
- Foldable metal bases for easy storage
- 6 month warranty

## Information
This artificial Christmas tree arch is made from flame-retardant plastic with a snow-dusted finish, supported by foldable metal bases. It turns an ordinary doorway into a festive entrance and gives you a tree that does not need floor space in the middle of a room. Pine cones are scattered through the full, lifelike tips for a wintry forest look. It suits hallways, living room openings and other indoor doorways, in modern or traditional Christmas schemes. The foldable bases make it easier to store until next year.

## Information
Transform your space into a festive wonderland with ease. This pre-lit masterpiece is not just any Christmas tree; it's a hassle-free, energy-efficient marvel designed to bring holiday cheer into your home or retail space. With its convenient timer function power supply, you can set your tree to illuminate your Yuletide celebrations precisely when you want them. Perfect for indoor use, this tree radiates the essence of Christmas, creating a merry ambiance that will warm hearts throughout the season. Experience the joy of effortless setup and breakdown. It's the perfect centrepiece for homes, shops, and Christmas retail displays alike. Don't let the holiday rush dampen your spirits. Embrace the simplicity and elegance of our Winter Wonderland Pop-Up Snow Flocked Christmas Tree, and let the festivities begin!

## Features
- Pop up design easy setup hassle free festive use
- Pre decorated silver baubles warm LEDs save time

## Information
Transform your space into a festive wonderland with ease. This pre-lit masterpiece is not just any Christmas tree; it's a hassle-free, energy-efficient marvel designed to bring holiday cheer into your home or retail space. With its convenient timer function power supply, you can set your tree to illuminate your Yuletide celebrations precisely when you want them. Perfect for indoor use, this tree radiates the essence of Christmas, creating a merry ambiance that will warm hearts throughout the season. Experience the joy of effortless setup and breakdown. Our pop-up design ensures that you can assemble and disassemble your tree in record time, all by yourself. No more wrestling with tangled lights or struggling with heavy branches. This tree springs to life in moments, allowing you more time to revel in the magic of the season. Decked out in snowy splendor and adorned with warm white LED lights, silver baubles in assorted finishes (Shiny, Matt, Glitter), this tree comes pre-decorated to save you time and effort. It's the perfect centrepiece for homes, shops, and Christmas retail displays alike. Don't let the holiday rush dampen your spirits. Embrace the simplicity and elegance of our Winter Wonderland Pop-Up Snow Flocked Christmas Tree, and let the festivities begin!

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Transforms space into festive wonderland with LEDs
- Timer function enables scheduled illumination control
- Rapid pop up design easy assembly no holiday hassle

## Information
Transform your space into a festive wonderland with ease. This pre-lit masterpiece is not just any Christmas tree; it's a hassle-free, energy-efficient marvel designed to bring holiday cheer into your home or retail space. With its convenient timer function power supply, you can set your tree to illuminate your Yuletide celebrations precisely when you want them. Perfect for indoor use, this tree radiates the essence of Christmas, creating a merry ambiance that will warm hearts throughout the season. Experience the joy of effortless setup and breakdown. Our pop-up design ensures that you can assemble and disassemble your tree in record time, all by yourself. No more wrestling with tangled lights or struggling with heavy branches. This tree springs to life in moments, allowing you more time to revel in the magic of the season. Decked out in snowy splendour and adorned with 150 warm white LED lights, this tree comes pre-decorated to save you time and effort. It's the perfect centrepiece for homes, shops, and Christmas retail displays alike. Don't let the holiday rush dampen your spirits. Embrace the simplicity and elegance of our Winter Wonderland Pop-Up Snow Flocked Christmas Tree, and let the festivities begin!

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Beautiful warm white glow
- Brown bark effect & flocked finish
- 5m power cable for easy display
- Stand & ground stakes included
- Snow flocked for a magical, wintry finish

## Information
Add a winter forest feel to your home this Christmas with our light up snowy twig tree. Beautifully illuminated by warm white LEDs to create a warm, welcoming feature. The twig tree comes in a choice of sizes and is suitable for indoor and outdoor display. To capture the colour and texture of a real tree, we've wrapped the tree in brown tape. The tape has a bark effect finish for a beautiful, natural look. Plus, it's waterproof to prevent it peeling in the rain. For an enchanting winter-weathered look, we've designed the tree with bare branches and a snow flocked finish. And for full effect, weve also added a light dusting of snow to the trunk and base. The twig tree includes a screw-on base and a set of ground pegs to secure it to your lawn. For a lifelike finish, weve also designed the base with bumps to resemble the roots of a real birch tree.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- The elegant black micro dot design offers a sleek, contemporary alternative to a traditional green Christmas tree.
- 400 warm white LEDs create a soft, sparkling glow that adds warmth to your festive display.
- Choose from 8 lighting modes, including twinkle, slow fade, steady on and more, to create your preferred festive atmosphere.
- Set the built-in timer to turn the lights on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours each day.
- Use the included remote control to change lighting modes and activate the timer from a distance.
- Mains powered with a 5m power cable for consistent illumination and convenient placement.
- The built-in timer runs the lights for 6 hours, switches them off for 18 hours and repeats daily.
- Suitable for indoor use and sheltered outdoor spaces.
- Measures 120cm, or 4ft, tall and has an 85cm x 85cm footprint.
- Includes a 1-year warranty for added peace of mind.

## Information
Create a contemporary festive display with this 4ft, 120cm black micro dot Christmas tree from Samuel Alexander. The sleek alternative to a traditional tree features 400 warm white LEDs for a soft, inviting glow. Choose from 8 lighting functions, including twinkle, slow fade and steady on, using the included white remote control. A built-in timer switches the lights on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours, repeating daily. The mains-powered design includes a 5m power cable and is suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use. The tree measures 120cm tall with an 85cm x 85cm footprint.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Beautiful warm white glow
- Brown bark effect & flocked finish
- 5m power cable for easy display
- Stand & ground stakes included
- Snow flocked for a magical, wintry finish
- Brown bark effect  flocked finish
- Stand  ground stakes included

## Information
Add a winter forest feel to your home this Christmas with our light up snowy twig tree. Beautifully illuminated by warm white LEDs to create a warm, welcoming feature. The twig tree comes in a choice of sizes and is suitable for indoor and outdoor display. To capture the colour and texture of a real tree, we've wrapped the tree in brown tape. The tape has a bark effect finish for a beautiful, natural look. Plus, it's waterproof to prevent it peeling in the rain. For an enchanting winter-weathered look, we've designed the tree with bare branches and a snow flocked finish. And for full effect, weve also added a light dusting of snow to the trunk and base. The twig tree includes a screw-on base and a set of ground pegs to secure it to your lawn. For a lifelike finish, weve also designed the base with bumps to resemble the roots of a real birch tree.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Modern twig shape gives a clean festive look indoors
- 150 cool white LEDs create bright steady seasonal light
- Flat base support helps keep the display stable
- Plug-in design makes setup quick and straightforward
- 4m lead wire offers flexible placement near sockets
- Fire-retardant construction provides an added safety feature for seasonal decorating.
- Mains-powered at 24 V and supplied with a UK BS IP44 transformer for straightforward connection.
- Plug-and-play operation and a 5 m power cable make setup straightforward for indoor or sheltered outdoor displays.
- A flat base and white metal frame provide a practical foundation for the pre-lit tree display.
- Covered by the applicable statutory warranty period.

## Information
Bring a festive focal point to your home with this 5ft Prelit Christmas Tree in a Firework style design. Made from PVC, it offers a practical seasonal decorating option for indoor spaces where you want an attractive Christmas display without the need to add separate lights yourself. The prelit format helps reduce setup time and makes it easier to create an inviting look straight away. Designed for straightforward seasonal use, this tree is suited to customers looking for a simple way to prepare a living room, hallway, office reception area or other indoor setting for Christmas. The firework style gives the tree a decorative appearance that can complement both traditional and modern festive themes, while the PVC construction provides a familiar material choice for artificial Christmas trees. As part of your seasonal decor, this tree can be styled with baubles, ribbons, garlands and other ornaments to suit your preferred look. Because it is prelit, you can focus on the finishing touches rather than arranging separate string lights first. That can be especially helpful when you want an easier decorating routine during the busy run-up to Christmas. The 5ft size makes it suitable for many homes and smaller spaces where a full Christmas tree effect is wanted without taking up too much room. It can work well as a main tree in compact areas or as an additional decorative feature in larger settings. Its festive look is designed to help create a welcoming atmosphere throughout the season. Please note that this product information confirms the tree is made from PVC and supplied in a prelit firework style at 5ft. No additional features should be assumed beyond the supplied source data. Always position and decorate artificial trees safely, and follow any fitting or care guidance provided with the product when setting up your display.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Slim pencil shape fits neatly into smaller festive spaces
- Pre-lit cool white LEDs give an instant glowing display
- Folding branches need little shaping for faster setup
- Green PVC build with metal stand supports reuse yearly
- Easy to fold away after use for simple storage
- Partial assembly is required, with folding branches designed for quick setup and little or no shaping.
- Green PVC foliage and a wrapped construction combine with a practical metal stand for indoor decorating.
- Available in 4ft to 8ft sizes, with the 6ft model featuring 430 tips and 180 cool white LEDs.
- The flame-retardant branches and sturdy metal stand support practical indoor festive decorating.
- Enjoy a ready-lit festive display without sourcing and fitting separate string lights.

- Pre-lit cool white LEDs give an instant glowing display
- Folding branches need little shaping for faster setup
- Green PVC build with metal stand supports reuse yearly
- Easy to fold away after use for simple storage
- Partial assembly is required, with folding branches designed for quick setup and little or no shaping.
- Green PVC foliage and a wrapped construction combine with a practical metal stand for indoor decorating.
- Available in 4ft to 8ft sizes, with the 6ft model featuring 430 tips and 180 cool white LEDs.
- The flame-retardant branches and sturdy metal stand support practical indoor festive decorating.
- Enjoy a ready-lit festive display without sourcing and fitting separate string lights.

## Information
Bring a neat festive look to your home with this 6ft slim pre-lit artificial pencil Christmas tree. The narrow profile is designed for spaces where a fuller tree may feel too wide, making it suitable for hallways, corners and other areas where you want seasonal decoration without taking up much room. Densely packed folding branches help create an attractive display with very little shaping or arranging, so setup is quick and straightforward. This artificial Christmas tree is finished in green and uses a wrapped construction with PVC tips and a metal stand. The combination of materials gives it a practical seasonal design that can be used again year after year. Because the branches fold neatly, the tree is easier to store when the season ends and simpler to bring out again for future celebrations. It is erected in minutes, which makes it a convenient option for busy households that want an instant decorative centrepiece without lengthy assembly. The tree is pre-lit with cool white LEDs, providing an illuminated festive effect without the need to add separate lights. This helps save time when decorating and creates a bright, consistent look once switched on. With 430 tips and 180 LEDs, it offers plenty of visual detail while keeping the slim pencil shape that works well in smaller rooms or more compact display areas. At 6ft tall, this tree offers a noticeable presence while remaining manageable for indoor decorating. The size is measured from top to bottom including the stand, helping you choose with confidence when planning your layout. Its 58cm width supports the slim profile, making it a practical choice where floor space is limited but you still want a classic Christmas tree appearance. Designed for decorative display, this pre-lit artificial tree suits home use as well as seasonal events and sheltered outdoor occasions where appropriate. It can also work well for themed decor, celebrations and event styling. The simple folding branch design makes it easy to store between uses, while the reusable construction supports repeated seasonal decorating. If you want a tidy festive centerpiece that combines convenience with an instant lighted finish, this slim pencil Christmas tree offers a straightforward solution for creating an inviting holiday display.

## Features
- Fibre Optic Christmas Tree
- Illuminated Star Topper
- Diamond Fibre Optic Tree
- Color-Changing Lights
- Built-in white LED lights create an inviting festive glow straight away, helping you set up your Christmas display more quickly without needing separate string lights or extra wiring around the branches.
- PVC finish gives the tree a classic seasonal look that suits traditional decorations, from baubles and ribbons to garlands and tree toppers chosen to match your style.
- Alaskan Pine design offers a timeless Christmas silhouette that works well in living rooms, hallways and other indoor spaces where you want a simple but effective festive centrepiece.
- Ready-lit construction makes decorating more straightforward by giving you an illuminated base before you add personal finishing touches, making seasonal preparation feel easier and less time-consuming.
- A practical choice for indoor festive decorating, this pre-lit tree combines familiar pine styling with built-in lighting to help create a cosy atmosphere for gatherings, meals and quiet winter evenings at home.

- PVC finish gives the tree a classic seasonal look that suits traditional decorations, from baubles and ribbons to garlands and tree toppers chosen to match your style.
- Alaskan Pine design offers a timeless Christmas silhouette that works well in living rooms, hallways and other indoor spaces where you want a simple but effective festive centrepiece.
- Ready-lit construction makes decorating more straightforward by giving you an illuminated base before you add personal finishing touches, making seasonal preparation feel easier and less time-consuming.
- A practical choice for indoor festive decorating, this pre-lit tree combines familiar pine styling with built-in lighting to help create a cosy atmosphere for gatherings, meals and quiet winter evenings at home.

## Information
Bring a bright festive finish to smaller rooms with this 3ft fibre optic Christmas tree. Its compact height makes it a practical choice for corners, tabletops, porches or other areas where space is limited, while still providing a seasonal focal point. The tree is designed as a pre-lit artificial decoration, so the lighting is built in and ready to use without adding separate strings of lights. With multicolour changing effects, it creates a lively display that adds warmth and movement to your Christmas décor. Made from PVC, the tree offers a reusable seasonal option for indoor decorating. The foliage has been designed to give a classic green Christmas tree appearance, while the fibre optic effect brings extra visual interest when switched on. A sturdy metal stand is included to help provide stability during display, making it suitable for repeated use across the season. The combination of compact size and built-in lighting means it can work well as a main feature in a smaller room or as an additional decorative piece alongside larger displays. The integrated fibre optic LED lights are designed to stay lit when the tree is powered on, producing a soft glow with a three-colour combination. This gives you an attractive decorative effect without needing extra accessories or complicated setup. Because the lights are built into the tree, it offers convenience as well as style for busy seasonal decorating. It is an easy way to create atmosphere at home while keeping your display neat and simple. This artificial Christmas tree is intended for indoor festive use and suits customers looking for a compact decorative option with built-in illumination. The 3ft height makes it manageable to position in different parts of the home, while the fibre optic lighting helps it stand out once evening falls. Whether used on its own or paired with other decorations, it provides a cheerful seasonal look that can be enjoyed year after year. As with any decorative product containing electrical lighting, ensure it is positioned safely and used according to the fitting guidance supplied with the item. Keep away from heat sources and place on a stable surface when in use. For those wanting an easy-to-style Christmas tree with colourful light effects and minimal setup, this pre-lit fibre optic design offers a simple and attractive solution for festive decorating.
Bring a touch of holiday spirit with this pre-lit Diamonds Fibre Optic LED Pre-Lit tree, perfect for creating a warm and festive atmosphere in your home.

## Features
- Quick and easy to assembly
- Energy efficient LEDs which last up to 50,000hrs
- Hinged Construction
- Made of high quality PE, PET and PVC mixed leaf
- Compact 4ft size makes this pre-lit Christmas tree well suited to smaller rooms, corners and hallways where floor space is limited but you still want a festive centrepiece with plenty of seasonal impact.
- Built-in warm white lights help create an inviting Christmas glow without the need to add separate string lights first, saving time during setup and making decorating feel quicker and more straightforward.
- PVC branch construction gives the tree a classic artificial finish that can be used again each year, offering a practical alternative to choosing and disposing of a fresh cut tree after the season ends.
- Traditional green colour works well with many decorating styles, so you can keep the look simple or personalise it with baubles, ribbons and other ornaments to suit your own home décor.
- Suitable for indoor festive display in living rooms, dining spaces or reception areas, this pre-lit tree offers an easy way to add Christmas atmosphere while keeping installation neat and manageable.

## Information
Bring a bright seasonal look to your home with this 5ft pastel stars and baubles fibre optic Christmas tree. Designed as an artificial Christmas tree, it offers a practical way to create a festive display that can be used year after year. The green finish gives it a classic tree appearance, while the fibre optic styling adds decorative colour for an eye-catching effect. This pre-lit tree is designed for easy installation and dismantling, making it straightforward to set up for the season and pack away afterwards. The automatically changing light colours help create a lively festive atmosphere without the need for extra decoration, and the flashing or off mode gives simple control over how the tree is displayed. With its compact 5ft height, it is suitable for a range of indoor spaces where a full festive look is wanted without taking up too much room. The tree is supplied with a metal stand for stable placement, helping it stand neatly in position during use. Its PVC and metal construction supports repeated seasonal decorating, while the artificial design means there is no need to worry about shedding needles. This makes it a convenient option for homes looking for an attractive Christmas centrepiece that can be enjoyed across multiple seasons. Ideal for creating a cheerful focal point in living rooms, hallways or family spaces, this fibre optic Christmas tree combines practical features with decorative appeal. The pastel stars and baubles styling offers a playful twist on traditional Christmas décor, while the built-in lighting helps reduce the need for additional string lights. Whether you are refreshing your existing festive display or choosing a new seasonal tree, this 5ft option provides an easy-to-use solution with a colorful illuminated finish. As an artificial indoor Christmas tree, it suits households that want a reusable decoration with straightforward assembly and storage between celebrations. The combination of green coloring, fiber optic light effects and sturdy stand makes it a versatile choice for seasonal decorating. With its simple operation and decorative design, this 5ft pre-lit tree helps you create a welcoming festive setting with minimal effort.
Bring a touch of holiday spirit with this pre-lit Pastel Stars and Baubles Fibre Optic tree, perfect for creating a warm and festive atmosphere in your home.

## Information
Bring a bright seasonal touch to your home with this 3ft pastel stars and baubles fibre optic Christmas tree. Designed for easy installation and dismantling, it offers a simple way to create an eye-catching festive display without the need for separate string lights. The artificial construction is intended for repeated seasonal use, helping you enjoy the same decorative look year after year. This tree features automatically changing light colours for a lively illuminated effect, while the flashing or off mode gives straightforward control over how it looks when in use. The green finish provides a classic Christmas tree base, complemented by pastel stars and baubles styling for a softer decorative feel. With its compact 3ft height, it is well suited to smaller rooms, tables, sideboards or other indoor display areas where space is limited but festive impact is still important. The tree includes a metal stand to support stable upright placement, making it practical for home decorating during the season. Its PVC and metal construction combines lightweight handling with a durable structure designed for indoor festive use. As an artificial tree, it can be stored away after Christmas and brought out again each year, reducing the need to replace your main seasonal decoration. Suitable for homes looking for an attractive pre-lit Christmas centrepiece, this fibre optic tree helps create a cheerful display with minimal setup. The integrated lighting removes the hassle of adding extra bulbs or separate wiring, while the finished look makes it easy to place in living rooms, hallways or family spaces. Whether used as a main feature in a smaller room or as an additional decorative accent elsewhere in the home, it offers a convenient and colorful way to celebrate the season. The design is also suitable where families want a decorative tree that can be positioned safely indoors alongside everyday household activity. Its artificial format avoids shedding needles and supports tidy seasonal decorating, while the pre-lit effect adds visual interest straight away. With its compact size and simple operation, this 3ft fiber optic Christmas tree provides an attractive festive option that balances style, convenience and repeat use across many Christmas seasons.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 5ft pre-lit tree gives an elegant festive focal point
- Mixed PE, PET and PVC tips create fuller texture
- White snow-dusted finish adds a classic winter feel
- Hinged design helps make assembly quicker and easier
- Metal stand included for stable indoor display use
- Fire-retardant artificial Christmas tree for festive indoor displays.
- Mains-powered warm white LED lighting includes a 2m cable for convenient connection.
- Hinged branch construction supports quicker, easier assembly for convenient Christmas setup.
- A sturdy metal stand provides stable support for the artificial Christmas tree.
- Warm white LEDs offer 8 lighting modes, including waves, sequential, chasing or flashing, slow fade, twinkle or flash, steady on and combination.
- 5ft pre-lit tree gives an elegant festive focal point
- Mixed PE, PET and PVC tips create fuller texture
- White snow-dusted finish adds a classic winter feel
- Hinged design helps make assembly quicker and easier
- Metal stand included for stable indoor display use
- Fire-retardant artificial Christmas tree for festive indoor displays.
- Mains-powered warm white LED lighting includes a 2m cable for convenient connection.
- Hinged branch construction supports quicker, easier assembly for convenient Christmas setup.
- A sturdy metal stand provides stable support for the artificial Christmas tree.
- Warm white LEDs offer 8 lighting modes, including waves, sequential, chasing or flashing, slow fade, twinkle or flash, steady on and combination.

## Information
Create a festive focal point in your home with this 5ft pre-lit Green Lapland Fir artificial Christmas tree. Designed to offer a full, elegant look, it combines mixed PE, PET and PVC foliage with various tip styles to help recreate the depth and texture of a natural tree. The green finish is enhanced with a white snow-dusted effect, giving the tree a classic winter appearance that suits traditional and modern seasonal décor alike. A warm white LED light set is already fitted to save time at Christmas and reduce the need for extra decorations if you prefer a simple, polished look. With eight lighting modes to choose from, you can tailor the ambience to suit family gatherings, quiet evenings or lively festive occasions. Options include waves, sequential, slogs, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on and combination, offering flexibility across different settings. The hinged construction is designed to make assembly more straightforward, helping you prepare for the season with less effort and less time spent fitting branches. Once assembled, the tree provides a practical indoor centerpiece that can be used year after year. It comes complete with a metal stand for support and stability during display. Made from high-quality mixed leaf materials including PE, PET and PVC, the tree is intended to deliver a balanced mix of style and convenience for seasonal decorating. Its reusable design makes it suitable for storing away between celebrations and bringing out again each year when you want a reliable festive feature. Whether placed in a living room, hallway or dining space, this pre-lit artificial Christmas tree offers an attractive way to create a warm seasonal atmosphere without the upkeep of a real tree. The combination of full branch structure, integrated lighting and easy assembly makes it a useful choice for households looking for an inviting Christmas display that feels both decorative and manageable.

## Features
- Smart App LED Control, Hello Fairy
- RGB Micro-LEDs, Dazzling Colours

## Information
Xmas Haus Pre-Lit RGB Christmas Tree Silhouette App Remote Controlled (1.4m) Bring a burst of festive colour to your home with this stylish RGB Christmas Tree Silhouette. Designed to create a warm and magical atmosphere, this sleek 1.4m tree features 140 vibrant RGB LED lights, evenly spaced 8 cm apart on a sturdy steel frame for perfect illumination from every angle. With a minimalist tree shape topped by a classic star, this modern decoration is ideal for wall or door mounting adding festive cheer without taking up any floor space. Choose from a variety of light effects and colours using either the Hello Fairy app or the included handheld remote control. The 3-meter transparent lead wire offers flexible placement options, and when the seasons over, the fold-flat design makes storage quick and easy.

- Make a grand statement with this light up tree

## Information
Create a winter wonderland this year with this Micro Dot Christmas Tree. This tree is the perfect choice for any display, whether it's by the fireplace, in the window or on show in the hallway, this is sure to bring the festive cheer to your home and those who visit this Christmas time even Santa himself! Suitable for indoor and outdoor use.

Create a winter wonderland this year with this Micro Dot Christmas Tree. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Frosted branches for winter charm
- Rustic wood block base for stability
- Ideal for holiday merchandise displays
- Versatile for traditional and contemporary styles
- Complements seasonal decor collections

## Information
This artfully arranged cedar tree captures the magic of winter with its delicately frosted branches set atop a rustic wood block base. The intricate dusting of snow creates a serene display that mirrors the quiet beauty of a forest after fresh snowfall. Perfect for seasonal displays in retail environments, this medium-sized piece serves as an ideal focal point for holiday merchandise arrangements. The realistic branch structure and thoughtful proportions make it an outstanding choice for both traditional and contemporary settings. For maximum visual impact, consider pairing with complementary items from our seasonal collection, such as the White Wash Collection Wooden Decorative Sleigh and our graduated series of wicker bell decorations from The Noel Collection. The natural pinecone sculptures on display bases offer additional textural elements that harmonize beautifully with the snowy cedar's organic form. This piece demonstrates exceptional attention to detail in its design, from the carefully positioned snow effects to the authentic wood block foundation that provides stability and style. The versatility of this decorative element makes it an essential addition to any retailer's seasonal inventory, appealing to customers seeking both understated winter decor and more elaborate holiday displays.
